review_note: 2026-10-20 figure 2 revision: color-assisted anatomical identity, external leader endpoints and dark-filled envelopes rechecked on original calibrated crop. Color raster is supporting evidence only; no color-image scale or resampling changes the measurement coordinates.
annotation_policy: Text labels, external leader lines and internal symbols identify fields but do not themselves form anatomy or excluded tissue. The region at a leader endpoint supplies the anatomical envelope.
